items.q: Jack Nicklaus, who has proven that a man, a heavy weight who has finesse and timing and feeling is better than any small man

ctx.x: Well, incidentally, Jimmy Thomson was the first long ball hitter of note in professional golf. This is quite significant, because today the game has come around in 1975, a game of long ball hitters dominating the game, such as the likes of Jack Nicklaus, who has proven that a man, a heavy weight who has finesse and timing and feeling is better than any small man, because he hits the ball so far. But at that time Jimmy Thomson was considered to be something of a freak of nature because he could hit the ball so…
